segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly report no irritation, dryness, or flaking, though one describes a hive-like reaction around her chin and stopped using it.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin found the serum essential alongside other actives, reporting glowing results with no irritation.

concerns.spots: Most reviewers report their dark spots or post-acne marks visibly fading within one to several weeks, but several say they saw no improvement even after a month of consistent use.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers note reduced redness or melasma, sometimes overnight, but one reports the serum made her face redder and another had a hive-like reaction and stopped using it.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers say the serum did not cause new breakouts, and a couple report fewer pimples or less inflamed acne since starting it.

aspects.libelle: Pump packaging is easy to use

extraits.texte: Have been using for over a month and have noticed no results. If anything, I have more dark spots on my cheeks. I'm giving in and purchasing a prescription strength hydroquinone cream.

extraits.titre: I would never ever buy this product again
extraits.texte: This is probably the worst product I ever bought at Ulta. One of the sales people literally followed me in the store and talk me into buying it and tell me how good it is. It was over $100 with tax and it didn't do one thing for me. I actually think it made my face redder. I am furious that I gave into this sales person.. at first I said no, but she persuaded me which is their job but when something is that expensive and doesn't work it's frustrating.

I have been suffering with a lot of acne scarring around my chin area, so I was really excited to try out the power bright dark spot system. I have only tried the a.m. serum solution and I think it is a little too harsh for my skin right now. On day two I noticed a hive like reaction around my chin so I stopped using the product. I'm gonna give my skin some to recover and try again because I would really love to see some positive results.

I have ultra sensitive skin with some dark spots from old acne scars. I've been looking for products to lighten the hyperpigmentation that don't irritate me, and this seems to works. This two-step product has AM and PM solutions. The AM doesn't bother my skin, but the PM mask has a slight tingle. My dark spots didn't vanish in 5 days, but have definitely gotten lighter. I will continue using and I'm excited to see how it progresses! Gifted by Dermalogica in exchange for my honest review.

I bought this on a whim at the store. I have combination and acne prone but also sensitive skin so I was skeptical, but figured I'd try it. And WOW!! Literally OVERNIGHT there was a HUGE noticable change!! My skin looked smoother overall and way less red and splotchy. I never write reviews on here but knew I had to for this one. I cant wait to see how my face looks after a week!

Choosing the correct serum is essential for my combination skin, and this one is amazing. I noticed results within a few days of using this serum. The combination of niacinamide, hexylresorcinol, shiitake mushroom, and ashwagandha leaves my skin glowing, and the light-diffusing technology is just amazing. My skin looks and feels great. Gifted by Dermalogica but love is my own.
